title: Northgate Tire Center Member Agreement — Packages on Several Vehicles
content:
# Packages on several vehicles

**Clause.** A Northgate Tire Center member may hold installation packages on as many vehicles as they own, and a new package on another vehicle never affects an existing one. Each package covers only the set of tires it was sold with; charges, credits, rotations and road hazard replacements on one package are never applied to another.

There is no maximum number of Northgate Tire Center packages one member may hold.

## The clause, point by point

| Question the clause settles | Answer |
|---|---|
| How many packages can one member hold? | As many as the vehicles they own; no per-member maximum is set. |
| Does booking a package on a second vehicle change the first vehicle's package? | Never. |
| What does a package cover? | Only the set of tires it was sold with. |
| Can a charge or credit booked on one package be counted on another? | Never; the same holds for rotations and road hazard replacements. |

## Hypothetical illustration

A member holds a package on a sedan and books a second package on a pickup truck. The sedan's package keeps its own charges, credits, rotations and road hazard replacements exactly as they were; a rotation recorded on the pickup's package does not appear on, and is not counted for, the sedan's package.
